exclusionsVerification.method: Conservative case-folded whole-word matching of fresh typos/nonces against permitted input strings, target-word matching against all prior typed/text/input/token/typo/target fields, and directory-label substring matching against all permitted input strings. Excluded expected/results fields. Every authored complete path includes a newly checked label; bare anchors and structural separators are grammar classes, not claimed fresh target words.

oracleProvenance.literals: Manually derived from frozen contract grammar. Exact bytes, including spelling, directory components and suffix, must be retained. No expected literal was replaced with baseline or candidate output.
oracleProvenance.ordinary: Independently chosen spelling pairs peopel -> people (en/bi; unchanged es) and qiero -> quiero (es/bi; unchanged en), verified on pristine c4a354f3 using all three actual lexicons. All eight final ordinary templates agree with baseline in all three modes.
oracleProvenance.controls: Document strings derived by explicit character edits, retaining the entire host suffix. Non-path controls c01/c03/c04/c06 agree with baseline in every mode. c02/c05 deliberately demand grammar preservation baseline does not yet provide. No candidate run performed.
oracleProvenance.state: Zero learning in private fields follows private policy; zero learning for recognized literal final components follows frozen contract. Public PersonalDictionary counters are observed without forcing save or learning. Fresh stack per case/mode avoids inherited state.
oracleProvenance.undo: Baseline public API calibration established that deleteUndoesLastEdit true followed by deleteBackward restores pre-correction spelling and removes the delimiter. Undo is a defined no-op when no autocorrection exists. c04 mode expectations were authored to this documented baseline affordance; it is not generic host undo.
oracleProvenance.intentionalMisses: These five desired-byte filesystem-intent expectations intentionally exceed admitted grammar. They retain the typed literal as expected in every mode, matching the contract development convention. Report every execution separately in its intentional-miss denominator. Their documented misses do not reject source; any ordinary/control/safety failure does. Do not rewrite their expected values to observed correction.

executionProtocol.policy: Fresh LanguageStack and PersonalDictionary(url:nil) per template per mode, actual en_US.pkdict/es.pkdict/en_es.pkdict, default KeyboardSettings with matching language. InputTraits standard, capitalization none to avoid unrelated automatic case changes, default autocorrection/spellchecking/learning; private false initially. Private operations toggle isSecure only. No text replacements are added. Sequential character taps; space uses insertSpace and newline uses insertReturn, not bulk paste.
executionProtocol.host: before and after form the entire initial host document with caret at their join; all text retained. Offsets count Swift Character (all selected/moved strings here are ASCII). TextDocument selection replaces selected range on insert. Refresh host contexts after every host edit.
executionProtocol.move: Move host caret by signed offset, collapse selection, then reconcileHostChanges before next operation. Out-of-bounds offsets are errors.
executionProtocol.select: Set absolute half-open [start,end) host selection, then reconcileHostChanges before next operation. Insertion replaces selected range. Invalid ranges are errors.
executionProtocol.backspace: Call engine.deleteBackward count times; omitted count is one. Do not replace with host-only deletion.
executionProtocol.undo: If engine.deleteUndoesLastEdit is true call engine.deleteBackward once, otherwise do nothing. This is a precise autocorrection-reversal operation; inability to inspect or invoke this affordance is an unavailable-operation error, never silently skipped.
executionProtocol.reset: Reconstruct KeyboardEngine attached to the SAME host document and SAME LanguageStack/personal dictionary, same settings and current traits. Preserve document, selection, private flag and learned state; discard transient engine composition/undo state. Do not clear personal dictionary or host text.
executionProtocol.private: Set current InputTraits.isSecure to enabled, keeping all other traits. Update engine traits immediately; disabling restores normal policy.
executionProtocol.sync: Call engine.reconcileHostChanges against current host context; no document edits.
executionProtocol.expectDocument: Operation-level exact full-document checkpoint after that operation, before any next operation. Final expectedByMode[mode] overrides expected. Never trim whitespace or normalize punctuation.
executionProtocol.expectState: Explicit extension: expectState.personalTotalCount equals stack.personal.totalCount; every expectState.personalCounts[word] equals stack.personal.count(of:word). Values are exact integers at the operation checkpoint, not deltas. No hidden state keys or inferred checks. Missing access to any field is an oracle error, not a skipped assertion.
executionProtocol.denominators: Run all 35 templates in all three stacks (105 executions). Preserve each category/mode denominator, all checkpoints, unavailable operations and oracle errors. Expected intentional misses stay visible. Any ordinary/control/safety failure rejects source; no post-reveal tuning. Literal acceptance is bounded to observed cases only.
executionProtocol.nonclaims: No native/device/runtime acceptance, R16 before-existing-text policy or R18 ranking claim. No deployment or source change.

readiness.revealRule: Copy/read these two artifacts once only after candidate and runner freeze. Hashes bind the authored expectations. Temporary authoring artifacts containing targets are removed after sealing.
